prompt: An Angular customer editor built with signals and reactive forms is reused when only the route id changes. The form keeps dirty values from the previous customer and an in-flight save can apply its success state to the newly routed customer. Repair ownership and cancellation while retaining route reuse: derive the active id from router state, reset/initialize the form intentionally, prevent stale async completion, and test id changes, validation errors, navigation away, and keyboard focus on the first invalid field. Keep the solution Angular-specific rather than importing React/Vue patterns.
